line.en: A precise editorial canvas where geometric constructions, graphs, and equations stay visibly linked as each idea is built.

for.en: Middle and high school mathematics course introductions and concept overviews connecting geometry, notation, graphs, and worked examples in algebra, functions, and introductory calculus.

not.en: Early-primary instruction, non-mathematical brand stories, footage-led videos, and long proofs requiring dense pages of notation.
